title: Fire Alarm Inspection Work Order Form
subtitle: Fire Alarm Inspection: connects authorized scope to results.
description: Fire Alarm Inspection Work Order Form covers fire alarm control unit, initiating devices, notification appliances, and interfaces. The facility fire-alarm coordinator records Fire Alarm Inspection authorized tasks, materials, results, and changes. Fire Alarm Inspection Work Order Form keeps Fire Alarm Inspection exceptions visible until the facility fire-alarm coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Fire Alarm Inspection Work Order Form at protected premises, panel location, zones, and sampled device locations. Document fire alarm control unit, initiating devices, notification appliances, and interfaces identity before Fire Alarm Inspection begins. Compare fire alarm control unit, initiating devices, notification appliances, and interfaces findings with stated Fire Alarm Inspection criteria; route unresolved Fire Alarm Inspection issues to qualified fire-alarm inspection supervisor. For Fire Alarm Inspection Work Order Form, confirm requirements for Fire Alarm Inspection. Ask qualified fire-alarm inspection supervisor to review Fire Alarm Inspection conditions beyond the facility fire-alarm coordinator's role.

sections.title: Work exception and scope changes
sections.guidance: Stop Fire Alarm Inspection at any scope or cost limit; honor facility fire-alarm coordinator access and safety boundaries.

blocks.label: Do not proceed without control
blocks.guidance: Stop normal processing when any required fire-alarm function is impaired without approved interim protection and accountable restoration. Protect fire alarm control unit, initiating devices, notification appliances, and interfaces; document the Fire Alarm Inspection notification and await qualified fire-alarm inspection supervisor direction.

blocks.label: Conditions requiring stop or renewed authorization

Device inventory or prior deficiency cannot be reconciled
blocks.guidance: For Fire Alarm Inspection, identify affected fire alarm control unit, initiating devices, notification appliances, and interfaces scope; ask facility fire-alarm coordinator to document the Fire Alarm Inspection immediate control before continuing.
